title: Lucky Man
desc: On the verge of divorcing his wife, a man explains his unhappy life to the Almighty. God then offers him a second chance at a happy ending.

title: KTM
desc: Karthik, a romantic at heart, navigates the hardships and complications of life while attempting to find his perfect match.

title: Bharaate
desc: Jagan, a local travel guide, falls in love with Radha, a tourist who visits his city. Though she leaves without saying goodbye, fate conspires to bring them together again.

title: Ayya
desc: An upright police officer is up against a conniving group of criminals. To put them behind bars, he devises a series of unconventional methods.

title: Paramathma
desc: Param, a wealthy young man, becomes romantically attached to Deepa. He soon learns that his friend Sanvi loves him and attempts to mend their relationship.
